archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-09.3 Provision and Configure Platforms
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
After the design is approved, the focus shifts to building and configuring the actual environments. IT and platform teams provision servers, containers, databases, and analytical tools according to the architecture plan.
They set up data storage systems, computing clusters, integration layers, and APIs. At the same time, they configure security controls — encryption, firewalls, role-based access, and monitoring tools. Automation scripts are used to deploy resources quickly and consistently, following infrastructure-as-code principles.
The goal is to create platforms that are reliable, reproducible, and compliant, while remaining adaptable to evolving needs.
Value created: Operational platforms that are configured, secure, and ready to support statistical production and analysis.
